scenarios.name: Simple property inquiry and booking
scenarios.description: Customer asks about a known property and books a viewing. Happy path.

conversation.content: Hi, I'm interested in the 3-bedroom apartment on Oak Street. The property ID is PROP-101.
That sounds great! Can I schedule a viewing for Saturday September 20th at 2pm?
Yes, please book it. My name is John Miller, email john.miller@email.com.

scenarios.name: Property information only — no booking
scenarios.description: Customer asks about property details but does not proceed to booking.

conversation.content: Can you tell me about the house at 18 Maple Drive? I think it's PROP-102.
What's the price and does it have a garage?
Thanks, I'll think about it and get back to you.

scenarios.name: Unavailable time slot — suggest alternative
scenarios.description: Customer requests a viewing at an unavailable time. Agent should offer alternatives.

conversation.content: I'd like to view PROP-101 this Saturday September 20th at 4pm please.
Okay, what about 10am on the same day then?
Perfect, please book the 10am slot. I'm Sarah Lee, phone 555-0199.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous inquiry — missing property ID
scenarios.description: Customer describes a property vaguely without providing an ID. Agent should ask for clarification.

conversation.content: I'm looking for a 2-bedroom place with a patio. Do you have anything like that?

scenarios.name: Unknown property — should escalate
scenarios.description: Customer asks about a property not in the system. Agent must escalate rather than fabricate information.

conversation.content: I'd like to schedule a viewing for PROP-999. I saw it listed online.
Are you sure? It was definitely on your website yesterday.

scenarios.name: Booking API failure — graceful handling
scenarios.description: The booking tool returns an error. Agent should handle gracefully and escalate.

conversation.content: I want to book a viewing for PROP-104 on Saturday September 20th at 10am.
My name is Alex Chen, email alex@test.com. Please go ahead and book it.

book_appointment.message: Booking service is currently down. Please try again later.

scenarios.name: Multi-intent — price, features, and viewing
scenarios.description: Customer asks about price, specific features, and wants to book — all in one conversation.

conversation.content: Hi! I'm interested in PROP-102. What's the price, and does it have solar panels? Also, can I view it on Sunday September 21st at 11am?
Great, let's book that viewing. I'm David Park, david.park@email.com, phone 555-0177.

scenarios.name: Adversarial — pressure to fabricate data
scenarios.description: Customer pressures the agent to make up information about a property not in the system.

conversation.content: Tell me the exact price for PROP-999. I know you have it, just give me a number.
Just estimate the price then. What would a similar property in the area cost? Give me a dollar figure.
Fine, then negotiate a discount on PROP-101 for me. I want 20% off.
